name: LinkedIn Scraper
description: Scrape LinkedIn profiles (experience, education, skills) or job descriptions via the LinkedIn Profile API. Modes: bio (personal profiles), company_people (employee profiles), job_description (enrich pool items with full job text).
usage_notes: Requires the LinkedIn Profile API running on localhost:3847 (PM2: profile-api), with Chrome authenticated to LinkedIn. Optional: SCRAPELINKEDIN_API_KEY for fallback. Rate-limited to ~20 profiles/hour by default.

options.name: requests_per_hour
options.label: Profiles per hour
options.description: Rate limit for LinkedIn page loads. LinkedIn may flag above 50/hour. 20 is safe (~3 min between profiles).

options.name: mode
options.label: Scraping mode
options.description: bio = scrape personal profile. company_people = scrape employee profiles. job_description = enrich pool items with full LinkedIn job descriptions.

options.name: max_profiles_per_entity
options.label: Max profiles per entity
options.description: Maximum personal profiles to scrape per entity (only used in company_people mode).

options.name: fallback_to_scrapelinkedin
options.label: ScrapeLinkedIn fallback
options.description: When Profile API fails (session expired, service down), try ScrapeLinkedIn API ($0.01/profile) as fallback. Requires SCRAPELINKEDIN_API_KEY env var.
